card.name: Second digit inside two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly 9 or 8, that comes right after a leading digit inside a multi-digit number. It shows up in addresses, temperatures, ages, percentages, citations and numbered lists.

modes.label: Digit 9 after a leading digit
modes.description: The digit 9 sits in the second place of a number such as 79, 69 or 89.
modes.example: Division of Plant Industry – Apiculture 8<<9>>95 East Main Street Reyn

modes.label: Digit in temperature or measure
modes.description: A middle digit in a Fahrenheit value or a measurement.

card.plain: It fires on the middle digit of a number that is being written out, such as the 9 in 89 or 79.
